name: Handout 11c: Spear of Leonidas
player_description:
SPEAR OF LEONIDAS
Three hundred held. None survived. The spear remembers.

Benefit: Reach 10 ft., +1d10 damage if you have not moved this turn.
Cost: At 0 HP, you stabilize automatically once per combat (Mars notices and tests you).
gm_notes:
WHEN: Session 5, Scene 2. Place face-down with the other arena weapon cards.
MECHANICS NOTE: The cost is ambiguous — stabilizing automatically sounds like a benefit. It is not. Mars noticing you is the cost. It means he is watching. It means the 'once at his choosing' from Handout 10 comes sooner and under worse conditions for a character who used this weapon. Do not explain this at the table. Let the player figure it out.
